verdicts.reason: Quote states memory is not erased by software reset (REQ-SRST-005). MUST_NOT is right. A scenario can check that memory contents survive a reset, for example by resetting and reading back. It isn't a per-cycle interface assertion, so check=scenario is right.

The quote only says diagnostics and recovery are not required, and verification is 'Not applicable'. It is a scope statement with nothing to verify or exercise. The exclusivity claim ('no other diagnostic...') is not testable.
